remaining.title: SVG export, and variable stroke width from velocity and ev.pressure
remaining.why: Both sit in mostWantedNext rather than in the fix list, and neither is a defect. Pressure-varying width in particular changes what the pen does under the hand and would want its own review round against the tremor and mouse-user personas rather than being slipped in beside fifteen other changes.

remaining.title: A last-three-attempts thumbnail strip
remaining.why: Partially covered rather than built: Clear is fully restorable via a snapshot, and Undo stroke now carries its own Undo in the toast, so the previous state is always one press away. A persistent history strip of past attempts would mean keeping discarded signatures around after the user has moved on, which cuts against the ephemerality the page now promises in writing. It deserves a deliberate decision, not an incidental one.
